sources.title: Spark-X2.6 API Pricing & Benchmarks | LMSpeed
sources.snippet: Spark-X2.6 is iFLYTEK's 293B-A30B mixture-of-experts model with a 1M-token context window, built for coding and agent tasks. The official model square lists a limited-time CNY tariff of ¥0.9 input and ¥3.6 output per million tokens, versus regular rates of ¥1.5 and ¥6. API access is available through iFLYTEK MaaS.
